spec.description:
Autex Composition Smooth Roll is a high-performance acoustic wallcovering
supplied in continuous 1.22m x 25m rolls with a sleek, flat-pile smooth finish.
Engineered to replace paint and wallpaper while dramatically reducing
reverberation and chatter, it provides floor-to-ceiling seamless wall coverage
without horizontal joins. Combining an acoustic polyester backing with a smooth
Vertiface surface, it is pinnable, hook-and-loop receptive, and Group 1 fire
rated for classrooms, offices, and commercial interiors.
features: Continuous roll form (1.22m x 25m) for seamless floor-to-ceiling application

Eliminates horizontal seams on
standard height walls
Pinnable, self-healing, and hook-and-loop receptive surface

Made from 100%
polyester fibre containing min 49% recycled PET

Group 1 fire rating to AS
ISO 9705 - 2003

Certified Carbon Neutral product with third-party verified
EPD
Durable and low-maintenance alternative to painting

install:
Inspect roll
material before cutting and ensure all rolls are from the same batch
Substrate must be flat, smooth, clean, dry, and sealed with wallboard sealer

Cut vertical drops slightly oversized to allow trimming at ceiling and
skirting

Hang in sequential order from the roll and maintain consistent
pile/grain direction

Apply recommended water-based acoustic wallcovering
adhesive using a notched trowel

Hang vertical drop onto wet adhesive and
smooth down from center outward

Butt join adjacent drops tightly without
overlapping

Roll thoroughly with a heavy smoothing roller to eliminate air
bubbles and ensure 100% bond

Trim top and bottom edges neatly using a
straight edge and fresh blade
selection_checklist:
Confirm total wall
length and height to calculate required roll meterage (each roll
covers 30.5m²)

Choose colour
from Autex Vertiface palette

Ensure batch numbers match across all ordered
rolls
Verify substrate is sealed to prevent excessive adhesive suction
accessories:
Autex
Edging Solutions Type A aluminium capping and joiner profiles

Heavy
wallcovering roller and trimming knives
limitations:
Must be installed
in vertical drops with pile running in the same direction

Substrate
imperfections can telegraph through; substrate must be smooth

Indoor use
only; avoid high moisture or exterior environments

retrieval.rag_summary:
Autex Composition Smooth Roll is a
continuous 1.22m x 25m roll of 10-12mm acoustic wallcovering engineered for
seamless floor-to-ceiling application. Composed of needle-punched thermally
bonded polyester with a smooth flat-pile Vertiface finish, it achieves an NRC
of 0.40 while creating a fully pinnable and hook-and-loop receptive wall
surface. Group 1 fire-rated and carbon-neutral certified, it replaces paint and
wallpaper in education and commercial spaces, absorbing distracting chatter and
echo across large wall expanses.
